entries.title: Luke 7:1
segments: And when He had ended all His words in the ears of the people, He entered into Capernaum.

entries.title: Luke 7:2
segments: And a certain servant of a centurion who was dear to him, was sick and ready to die.

entries.title: Luke 7:3
segments: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent the elders of the Jews to Him, begging Him that He would come and heal his servant.

entries.title: Luke 7:4
segments: And coming to Jesus, they begged Him earnestly, saying that he was worthy, he for whom You give this;

entries.title: Luke 7:5
segments: for, [they said], He loves our nation, and he has built us a synagogue.

entries.title: Luke 7:6
segments: Then Jesus went with them. But He being yet not far off from the house, the centurion sent friends to Him, saying to Him, Lord, do not trouble Yourself. For I am not worthy that You should enter under my roof.

entries.title: Luke 7:7
segments: Therefore neither did I think myself worthy to come to You; but say a word, and my servant will be healed.

entries.title: Luke 7:8
segments: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers. And I say to one, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does [it].

entries.title: Luke 7:9
segments: And hearing these things, Jesus marveled at him. And turning to the crowd following Him, He said, I say to you, I have not found such faith, no, not in Israel.

entries.title: Luke 7:10
segments: And they who were sent, returning to the house, found the sick servant well.

entries.title: Luke 7:11
segments: And it happened on the next day, He went into a city called Nain. And many of His disciples and a great crowd went with Him.

entries.title: Luke 7:12
segments: And drawing near the gate of the city, even behold, one having died was being carried out, an only son of his mother, and she was a widow. And a considerable crowd of the city was with her.

entries.title: Luke 7:13
segments: And when the Lord saw her, He had compassion on her and said to her, Do not weep.

entries.title: Luke 7:14
segments: And He came and touched the bier. And the ones who bore [him] stood still. And He said, Young man, I say to you, Arise!

entries.title: Luke 7:15
segments: And the one who was dead sat up and began to speak. And He delivered him to his mother.

entries.title: Luke 7:16
segments: And fear came on all. And they glorified God, saying, A great prophet has risen up among us; and, God has visited His people.

entries.title: Luke 7:17
segments: And this report of Him went out in all Judea, and in all the neighborhood.

entries.title: Luke 7:18
segments: And his disciples reported all these things to John.

entries.title: Luke 7:19
segments: And John, calling near a certain two of his disciples, sent [them] to Jesus, saying, Are You He that should come, or do we look for another?

entries.title: Luke 7:20
segments: And coming to Him, the men said, John the Baptist has sent us to You, saying, Are You He who should come, or do we look for another?

entries.title: Luke 7:21
segments: And in the same hour He cured many of infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits. And He gave sight to many who were blind.

entries.title: Luke 7:22
segments: And answering, Jesus said to them, Go and tell John what you have seen and heard; that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the gospel is proclaimed to the poor.

entries.title: Luke 7:23
segments: And blessed is [he] who shall not be offended in Me.

entries.title: Luke 7:24
segments: And when the messengers of John had departed, He began to speak to the people concerning John. What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

entries.title: Luke 7:25
segments: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed with soft clothing? Behold, those in splendid clothing and being in luxury are in kings' palaces.

entries.title: Luke 7:26
segments: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I say to you, and much more than a prophet.

entries.title: Luke 7:27
segments: This is [he] of whom it is written, "Behold, I send My messenger before Your face, who shall prepare Your way before You."

entries.title: Luke 7:28
segments: For I say to you, Among [those] who are born of woman there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist. But he who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

entries.title: Luke 7:29
segments: And all the people and the tax-collectors who heard [Him] justified God, being baptized [with] the baptism of John.

entries.title: Luke 7:30
segments: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, not being baptized by him.

entries.title: Luke 7:31
segments: And the Lord said, To what then shall I compare the men of this generation? And to what are they like?

entries.title: Luke 7:32
segments: They are like children sitting in a market and calling to one another, and saying, We have played the flute to you, and you have not danced; we have mourned to you, and you did not weep.

entries.title: Luke 7:33
segments: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, He has a demon.

entries.title: Luke 7:34
segments: The Son of man has come eating and drinking, and you say, Behold a gluttonous man and a winebibber, a friend of tax-collectors and sinners!

entries.title: Luke 7:35
segments: But wisdom has been justified by all her children.

entries.title: Luke 7:36
segments: And one of the Pharisees asked Him to eat with him. And going into the Pharisee's house, He reclined.

entries.title: Luke 7:37
segments: And behold, a woman, a sinner in the city, knowing that He reclined in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster vial of ointment.

entries.title: Luke 7:38
segments: And she stood behind [Him], weeping at His feet, and she began to wash His feet with tears and wipe them with the hair of her head. And [she] ardently kissed His feet and anointed [them] with the ointment.

entries.title: Luke 7:39
segments: But seeing this, the Pharisee who had invited Him, spoke within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what kind of woman [this is] who touches him, for she is a sinner.

entries.title: Luke 7:40
segments: And answering, Jesus said to him, Simon, I have something to say to you. And he said, Teacher, speak.

entries.title: Luke 7:41
segments: There was a certain creditor who had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and [the] other fifty.

entries.title: Luke 7:42
segments: And they having nothing to pay, he freely forgave both. Then which of them do [you] say will love him most?

entries.title: Luke 7:43
segments: And answering, Simon said, I suppose that one to whom he forgave most. And He said to him, You have judged rightly.

entries.title: Luke 7:44
segments: And He turned to the woman and said to Simon, Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, yet you gave Me no water for My feet. But she has washed My feet with tears, and has wiped [them] with the hair of her head.

entries.title: Luke 7:45
segments: You gave Me no kiss, but this woman, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss My feet.

entries.title: Luke 7:46
segments: You did not anoint My head with oil, but this woman has anointed My feet with ointment.

entries.title: Luke 7:47
segments: Therefore I say to you, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, he loves little.

entries.title: Luke 7:48
segments: And He said to her, Your sins are forgiven.

entries.title: Luke 7:49
segments: And those reclining with [Him] began to say within themselves, Who is this who even forgives sins?

entries.title: Luke 7:50
segments: And He said to the woman, Your faith has saved you, go in peace.
